autoTag.maxTotalDesc: Upper bound on how many interest tags one article can receive

autoTag.aiMaxTotalDesc: Upper bound on how many AI tags one article can receive
autoTag.queueUnavailable: Queue status unavailable (API not ready or request failed)
autoTag.backfillDesc: Queue articles that were never tagged, failed, or finished with zero tags (empty AI result). Articles that already have tags are skipped unless you force re-tag. Set days to 0 for the entire library (no date filter). Queue priority is newest published first (articles without a publish date fall back to fetch time) — newly ingested articles cut ahead of an old backlog.
autoTag.backfillForceDesc: Also re-queue done articles that already have tags (spends AI tokens again on everything in the window)
autoTag.clearQueueDesc: After clearing, run backfill again — newest by ingest time are processed first.
autoTag.clearQueueConfirm: This stops current tagging and removes pending, processing, and failed items. Done history is kept. Nothing is re-queued automatically — click Run backfill when ready.

wordcloud.desc: Manage word-cloud stopwords and the entity dictionary. Entity display names can be edited here; the shared osinttools seed is never overwritten (copy-on-write to a papr-local file).
wordcloud.stopwordsHint: Stop words for the word cloud (function words, noise domains, …). {{count}} words, version {{version}}.
wordcloud.entitiesHint: Entity dictionary maps aliases to canonical names and colours. {{count}} entities, version {{version}}.
wordcloud.cowHint: First save copies entities to {{dir}} — the shared osinttools file stays unchanged.
wordcloud.addEntityHint: Promote a residual cloud token (e.g. lowercase ai) or add a gazetteer entry. Matching is case-insensitive. The cloud remaps aliases to the new canonical right away; optional Term index → Backfill rewrites stored terms.
wordcloud.residualHint: Cloud labels that do not appear here are residual tokens from article text. Use Add entity to promote them (e.g. ai → AI) so counts merge under the new canonical.
wordcloud.editBackfillHint: After save, the cloud remaps aliases to the current canonical immediately. Run Term index → Backfill if you want article_terms rewritten for durable storage.
wordcloud.backfillDesc: Articles are tokenized once into a local SQLite term table so the cloud stays fast. New items index on ingest; use backfill for older articles or after a dictionary reload.
